load_joint_Btn.tip: Use the selected joint for the push system.
load_joint_Btn.what: Puts the selected joint in the field; the push guides are made around it.
steps: Check the sides you want (front / back / in / out).
examples: Select the elbow joint and click <<.
Load the elbow to add push joints to an arm.
load_joint_Btn.details: fill_push_object(): PushCorrectives.PushSystem().identify_push_joints(source, side) for each checked side, so Build can reuse push joints that already exist.

push_guides_Btn.what: Creates the guides for a push joint system around the joint in the field.
steps: Move the guides out to where the skin should push.
examples: Load the knee joint, click it, move the guides to where the skin should push out.
Create guides on the hip for the buttock push.

push_build_Btn.what: Builds the push joint systems from the push guides.
examples: Click it, bend the knee: the push joints keep the volume.
Build, then skin the push joints in the bend area.
push_build_Btn.details: create_push_system() on every push system made by Create guides in this session. Reopening the tool forgets them: load the joint again.

geo_line_button.what: Puts the selected geometry in the geo field.
examples: Select the body mesh and click <<.

create_correctives_button.what: Makes the corrective shapes on the geo for the template picked in the list.
examples: Pick the biped template, click Create, then sculpt each shape.
Make shoulder correctives for a muscular character.
create_correctives_button.details: blendshapes_correctives.BSP_Correctives(geo, template).create_correctives(): one blendShape target per pose in the template.

connect_button.tip: Connect the correctives to the controllers.
connect_button.what: Drives each corrective shape from the rig pose that needs it.
examples: Click it, bend the elbow: the corrective turns on by itself.
Connect so correctives fire with animation.
connect_button.details: connect_correctives(geo, blendshape_name, template): each target weight is driven by its pose reader on the rig.

connect_mirror_button.what: Mirrors the correctives to the other side and connects them.
examples: Sculpt the left side only, click it to get the right side.
Mirror the left knee correctives to the right.
connect_mirror_button.details: connect_correctives(..., mirror=True): mirrors the targets to the other side and connects them.
